answer: Require each agent to lock a refundable stake in a public lagoon of escrowed deposits before it can transact. The stake acts as a quartz-hard bond: honest agents reclaim it after a history of attested work, while a Sybil operator must fund every mirror identity separately, multiplying the capital cost of each fake account. Slashing the stake on proven fraud makes mass identity creation expensive and unprofitable, while keeping entry open for a single legitimate agent.
